'''Shafr Center''' was an academic institution<ref name="Tessent" /> that shared its name with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Shafr system/Legends|Shafr system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> It was affiliated with [[Shafr Center Press/Legends|The Shafr Center Press]], which in [[38 ABY]] published the [[Book/Legends|work]] ''[[The Shafr Anthology of Galactic Language, Second Edition]]''.<ref name="Written" /> At some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="3 ABY" /> the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Follnor Callat]], who was notorious in academic circles and was disavowed by several [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[University/Legends|universities]], was also dismissed from Prime Campus of Shafr Center.<ref name="Tessent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shafr Center was introduced in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Race for the Tessent]]," which was published for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Tessent" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref>
